disposition_reason: The original paper contains an ordered estimator-validation route: Fig. 3e/f recovery of known across/within shared variance and dimensionality on simulated data, with pCCA comparison, plus Supplementary Fig. 4 method comparisons on neural recordings. The authorized overhaul can select this original source task. Exact original simulation draws/trial-count grid, baseline arrays, loss aggregation and matched evaluation protocol remain unrecovered; in-sample pupil R² is retained only as descriptive calibration.

source_paper.title: Interactions across hemispheres in prefrontal cortex reflect global cognitive processing

evidence.locator: Fig. 3e/f and Results: pCCA-FA partitions across- and within-area shared variance; Methods: Fitting pCCA-FA, Simulated data generation, Fitting pCCA-FA and pCCA to simulated data; Supplementary Fig. 4 as referenced; Fig. 6c for descriptive context
evidence.supports: Fig. 3 compares recovery against known ground truth over thirty simulated datasets per trial-count condition. Methods specify Gaussian loading draws, thirty neurons per area, five across/three within dimensions, target variance ratios, EM and crossvalidated dimension selection. Fig. 6 pupil R²=.25 is a separate descriptive result.
Published data record contains original neural/pupil session and geometry files; metadata review does not verify native payload joins.

evidence.supports: Official pCCA-FA model decomposes across- and within-population interactions; no benchmark improvement result follows from source availability.

evidence.supports: Existing full descriptive evaluator reports covariance, dimensions, in-sample pupil regressions and dependent session-shuffle controls; protected neural-to-pupil remains separate.

evidence.supports: Visible generator uses thirty draws, trial counts100/150/300/600/1000/1500, five-fold CV, dimension candidates0–14 and no warmstart. Seed j*30+i is passed to crossvalidation, not explicitly to the simulator; source-paper 1–10 dimensionality policy requires reconciliation.

evidence.supports: S4 alternative-model driver evaluates joint FA, individual FA and pCCA on the same left/right fast-component session data and saves CV likelihood arrays; exact comparison normalization and published numeric results are unresolved.

target.description: Recover known across-area and within-area percentage shared variance (%sv) and shared dimensionality (d_shared) from the paper simulated two-population datasets, matching Fig. 3e/f. Original pCCA and pCCA-FA fitting comparisons are retained. Supplementary Fig. 4 neural method comparisons are a separately identified source validation route, not pooled into the recovery score.

dataset.description: Original Fig. 3 simulated datasets from the source pCCA-FA Gaussian model. Inspected author driver saves simdataset_varyN_noWS.pkl and sim/estimated/pCCA parameters; exact historical artifact binding and generator random state are not recovered. New simulations cannot silently substitute.

cohort.description: Paper defines thirty neurons per area, five across-area and three within-area dimensions, thirty ground-truth draws per trial-count setting. Inspected author driver lists100,150,300,600,1000,1500 trials and thirty draws each; exact historical draw identity and release-to-paper binding remain unresolved.

split.description: Paper simulation Methods gives dimension candidates1–10 with crossvalidation and all-trial refit; empirical fitting uses ten folds and1–15. Inspected Fig3 driver instead uses five folds and candidates0–14, with no warmstart and seed j*30+i for CV. The source-version/dimensionality discrepancy and historical fold identities must be resolved, not silently chosen.

inputs.description: Observed activity x from both simulated populations generated by the source model. Candidate estimation must use the same observations and neuron/trial support as pCCA-FA/pCCA; ground-truth parameters supply evaluator comparison targets, not candidate inputs.

preprocessing.description: Source generator draws across/within loading entries from standard normals, rescales singular values to approximately15% across-area and10% within-area shared variance, and scales independent variance to75%. Model fitting uses exact EM and SVD ordering; source d_shared definitions and loading-to-variance normalization must be preserved.

metric.description: Fig. 3 reports estimated versus true across/within %sv and d_shared; closeness to known truth is ordered, but an exact source-defined scalar recovery loss and its units/combination have not been recovered. Do not invent an average over these different endpoints. Source crossvalidated likelihood is an additional ordered fitting/comparison measure with separate normalization still unresolved.

aggregation.description: Fig. 3e/f shows mean and one standard deviation across thirty generated datasets per trial-count setting, keeping across/within and %sv/d_shared separate. Exact numeric baseline curves, hemisphere aggregation and any primary recovery summary remain unrecovered; random draws, not simulated neurons or folds, are the replication units.

comparison.primary_metric: Source Fig. 3 ground-truth recovery error for across/within %sv and d_shared; exact source loss and summary unresolved

published_baseline.description: Fig. 3e/f provides recovery curves for pCCA-FA and pCCA but exact numeric arrays and a source-matched recovery loss/summary remain unrecovered. The empirical pupil mean R²=.25 is descriptive context and is not the estimator-performance baseline. Supplementary Fig. 4 numeric likelihood/comparison results also remain unrecovered.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Author route is main_analyses/create_fig3_dataset_varyN.py plus official pCCA-FA/pCCA libraries; empirical S4 uses main_analyses/fit_alt_models.py. Source drivers were inspected, but release binding, original simulation RNG/artifacts, full fits and baseline arrays were not authenticated or rerun. Existing descriptive evaluator cannot replace this route.

minimum_effect.rationale: Choose a meaningful source-specific reduction in recovery error only after exact original errors, trial-count conditions and estimator variability are recovered; do not invent a common margin across variance percentages and integer dimensions.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired recovery-error comparisons across the same independently generated ground-truth datasets at each source trial-count setting; preserve separate endpoints and account for multiple conditions. Exact decision rule awaits source-array and loss recovery.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Independently drawn ground-truth parameter set plus its generated dataset (thirty per source trial-count setting); neural-recording validation uses sessions nested within three animals.
uncertainty.rationale: Neurons, latent dimensions, overlapping folds and two areas are not independent simulation replicates; the paper mean±SD is descriptive variability, not an improvement confidence rule.

paper_win_requires: Recover the original Fig. 3 parameter draws/datasets, trial-count grid, dimension search, crossvalidation and final fitting protocol, exact ground-truth metrics and numeric pCCA-FA comparator.
Surpass the source pCCA-FA estimator on the same original recovery task and all original conditions with a justified loss and uncertainty rule; beating only the weaker pCCA control is insufficient.
Preserve %sv and d_shared endpoints separately unless the source supports an exact combined summary; no cherry-picked trial counts, altered generator or favorable seed subset.
A fresh simulation draw set, changed variance ratio/dimensionality, new empirical split or protected pupil prediction is an extension, even if both methods are rerun.
Higher in-sample pupil R², larger covariance components, stronger significance or closer descriptive reconstruction is not an estimator-recovery win.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was performed; source results, any future author rerun, and current SOTA are separate comparators.

episode.improvement_loop: Blocked until the original source simulation artifacts, baseline and endpoint aggregation are recovered. After admission, permit estimator development only on declared source development inputs; keep assessment ground truth and original comparison artifacts evaluator-owned.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze estimation method, hyperparameters, dimension-selection policy, source condition coverage and scoring summary before final comparison on the recovered original Fig. 3 assessment datasets.
episode.final_evaluation: Compare candidate recovery with published and authenticated rerun pCCA-FA on identical original datasets and all source trial-count conditions. Any original Supplementary Fig. 4 likelihood comparison must retain its own exact empirical splits/normalization and be reported separately.
episode.baseline_policy: Source pCCA-FA is the performance comparator; pCCA/FA are source controls. Published results, author reruns and current SOTA remain distinct. Existing covariance/pupil reconstruction is calibration; new protected prediction or newly generated simulations cannot silently replace original paper assessment. Where the original method defines stochastic sampling, a source-supported protocol-equivalent rerun with recorded new random state, calibration tolerance and paired candidate/reference support is admissible; historical RNG state is not an independent prerequisite. This does not authorize changed sampling rules, population, input privilege or endpoint.

blocking_issues: Authenticate original simdataset_varyN_noWS.pkl and parameter/sample draws, generator RNG, trial grid and source-release bindings; the visible CV seed is not an explicit simulation seed.
Recover source %sv/d_shared numeric curves, exact comparison loss/aggregation and author variability; no invented scalar benchmark.

Reconcile paper simulation dimensions1–10 with inspected driver0–14, and paper empirical ten-fold policy with the Fig3 driver five-fold CV; freeze the correct original branch and EM/no-warmstart policy.
Recover Supplementary Fig. 4 empirical comparison endpoint, per-session folds and likelihood normalization before making that separate source-method claim.
Implement evaluator/author baseline route; justify task-specific minimum effect and uncertainty; fix concrete access/resource budgets.

legacy.notes: Preserve all existing P01–P05 covariance/pupil outputs, fixed examples and historical empirical assay. Published pupil mean R²=.25 and its within-area comparators are descriptive calibration only. The authorized overhaul selects the paper original Fig. 3 estimator-recovery task; no simulation, model fit or improvement has been run.
